    How to use

    Three steps, no tools.

    1. Shake well

      The bottle says to shake well before use, so give it a good shake each time.

    2. Add the drops

      Squeeze in 2 drops for every 1 litre of petrol or diesel you are filling.

    3. Fill the tank

      Top up with fuel as usual and ride or drive off. Nothing else changes.

    Questions

    Quick answers.

    What is Moto Vac Bio-Oil?

    A mileage enhancer that you mix into petrol or diesel. It comes in a small dropper bottle, so you add it a few drops at a time.

    How much do I add?

    2 drops for every 1 litre of petrol or diesel, as printed on the bottle. The dose finder above does the arithmetic for any fill-up.

    Do I need to shake the bottle first?

    Yes. The label asks you to shake well before use.

    How long does a bottle keep?

    The label says best before 2 years from the manufacturing date.

    What does it cost?

    MRP is ₹375 per bottle, inclusive of all taxes.

    Who makes it?

    Moto Vac markets it from T. Nagar, Chennai. It is manufactured by Rinuja Hi-Tech Bio-Power P. Ltd., Dindigul, and the label notes support from TREC-STEP, TDB, DST, Govt. of India.
